title: An Octopus Has Three Hearts 🐙 #Shorts
script: An octopus has three hearts. Two pump blood through the gills, while the third sends oxygenated blood around the rest of the body. Their blood also uses a copper based protein called hemocyanin, which gives it a bluish color. This unusual circulation helps octopuses survive in cold, low oxygen ocean environments. Three hearts, blue blood, and eight arms make an octopus one remarkable animal. Follow for more animal facts.

scenes.sub: They move blood through respiratory organs.
